steps.title: Recover from rejected revision commands and lease boundaries
preconditions: Run tracer app -- test services revision-safety against ephemeral local Miniflare with synthetic users, denied outbound, and pinned trusted runtime. Preserve its original 123 HTTP checks and all 18 runtime callbacks.
The existing appendix leaves three tombstones at head 11, epoch 5, timing 4, plus retained discussion. This extension uses sequential viewer snapshot and full journal observations after each refusal.

No native, websocket, fault injection, persistence restart, live account or provider behavior is claimed. Lease wall clock fields are omitted from content equality and separately checked against the acquired proof.
actions: Complete tracer app -- test services revision-safety original 123 HTTP checks
POST leases repeat member opening tombstone
POST leases owner conflicting member opening lease
PATCH leases member valid current proof
POST commands new scene then delete absent item
POST commands change tombstone scene kind to character
POST commands delete existing scene tombstone
POST restore member replay owner receipt
POST restore owner reused receipt with seq=1
POST commands retry failed transaction ID with new scene only

expectations.description: Thirteen exact refusals preserve sequential viewer snapshot and complete journal. Lease POST retry returns the same secret receipt; unsupported PATCH preserves the public lease, and cross-actor/changed restore receipt retries reject.

A two-operation transaction inserts a new scene then refuses a missing deletion. Every rejection leaves exact prior public state. A corrected retry using that failed command ID persists the new scene at version one with before=null and exactly one independently expected receipt/event; exact replay is inert.

mappings.why: Missing delete and kind-change attempts reject while exact state remains stable. Corrected retry recovers the first put and command ID after atomic rollback.
Viewer fresh command rejects read_only and preserves exact current content and full journal.
PATCH with valid held member lease proof returns method_not_allowed and retains exact lease identity.
An unknown project revision route returns not_found and preserves exact current content/journal.
